intro: Baltimore rewards visitors with a walkable harbor, world-class museums, and a proud local food scene. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Light rail runs from BWI Airport to the Inner Harbor in about 30 minutes for $2.
MTA buses, light rail and subway cost $2 per ride; a day pass is $4.60.
The Charm City Circulator bus is free and links the harbor, Fells Point and Mount Vernon.
MARC and Amtrak trains connect Penn Station to Washington, D.C. in about an hour.
Uber and Lyft both operate widely; taxis are metered but less common.
Driving is optional; parking downtown runs about $5 per hour near the harbor.

aquarium.name: National Aquarium
aquarium.price_text: ≈ USD 45–55 adult · cheaper for children · check on the day
aquarium.hours: Daily, usually 09:00–17:00 · later in summer · check on the day
aquarium.tip: Book a timed ticket online and go at opening to beat the crowds.

peabody.name: George Peabody Library
peabody.price_text: Free to enter during open hours
peabody.hours: Weekdays daytime · limited weekend hours · check on the day
peabody.tip: Look up from the atrium floor for the best photo of the stacked balconies.

jhu.name: Johns Hopkins University
jhu.price_text: Free to walk the Homewood campus
jhu.hours: Campus grounds open daily · buildings vary
jhu.tip: Walk the Homewood quad and the beach by the library for a calm break from downtown.

lexington.name: Lexington Market
lexington.price_text: Pay per stall · cash and card
lexington.hours: Mon–Sat daytime · closed Sunday · check on the day
lexington.tip: Try a crab cake or a local favorite at the counter stalls; go hungry.

fellspoint.name: Fells Point waterfront walk
fellspoint.hours: Always open · bars busiest in the evening
fellspoint.tip: Walk cobblestone Thames Street and the pier for harbor views, then stop for a drink.

fortmchenry.name: Fort McHenry National Monument
fortmchenry.price_text: ≈ USD 15 adult · under 16 free · check on the day
fortmchenry.tip: Watch the flag change and walk the seawall for harbor views.

federalhill.name: Federal Hill Park
federalhill.tip: Climb to the top for the classic skyline and Inner Harbor view.

americanvisionary.name: American Visionary Art Museum
americanvisionary.price_text: ≈ USD 15 adult · check on the day
americanvisionary.tip: Quirky outsider art; the building and sculpture plaza are worth the visit alone.

watertaxi.name: Inner Harbor water taxi
watertaxi.price_text: ≈ USD 12–18 day pass · check on the day
watertaxi.tip: A cheap way to hop between the harbor, Fells Point and Fort McHenry.

mtvernonwalk.name: Mount Vernon historic walk
mtvernonwalk.tip: See the Washington Monument and 19th-century townhouses on foot.

bmoremuseum.name: Baltimore Museum of Art
bmoremuseum.price_text: Free general admission · special shows may charge
bmoremuseum.hours: Closed Mon–Tue · Wed–Sun daytime · check on the day
bmoremuseum.tip: Free entry and a strong modern collection; pair it with the sculpture garden.

crabcake.name: Crab cake lunch in Fells Point
crabcake.tip: Maryland crab cakes are the local must-eat; ask for lump meat.

harborplace.name: Inner Harbor promenade
harborplace.tip: Stroll the waterfront and watch the boats; good for an easy evening.

orioles.name: Orioles game at Camden Yards
orioles.price_text: ≈ USD 15–60 depending on seat · check on the day
orioles.tip: Buy tickets online and arrive early for the ballpark food.

powhatan.name: Patterson Park
powhatan.tip: A big local park with a pagoda viewpoint; good for a quiet walk.

stays.why: Walk to the National Aquarium, the historic ships and Fort McHenry ferries. Easiest base for first-timers.
Cobbled waterfront streets full of pubs and seafood. Quiet at night, close to the harbor.
Museums, the Washington Monument and grand old streets. Good value and central.
Local restaurants and a hilltop view over the harbor. Short walk to the Inner Harbor.

food: Order a Maryland crab cake: mostly lump crab, little filler. Prices vary by season, so check the menu.
Try steamed blue crabs in summer. They are messy and sold by the pound; ask for a table outside.
Fells Point has old waterfront taverns and seafood spots. Book ahead on weekend evenings.
Cheap eats: pit beef sandwiches and crab soup at local delis and markets, often under $15.
Lexington Market is a good lunch stop for local stalls. Check opening days before you go.
more_time: Add a day for Fort McHenry and the Star-Spangled Banner story; check the ferry or bus times on the day.
Train to Washington, D.C. from Penn Station takes about an hour on MARC or Amtrak. Easy day trip.
Art lovers can swap a harbor afternoon for the Baltimore Museum of Art and the Walters Art Museum.
